name: bug-screenshot-tool
description: BUG截图工具 - 快捷键截图+标注+录入BUG

scripts.copy-renderer: mkdir -p dist/renderer/viewer dist/renderer/shared dist/renderer/stack dist/renderer/combine dist/renderer/record dist/scripts dist/assets && cp src/renderer/index.html src/renderer/screenshot.js src/renderer/style.css src/renderer/img-preview.html src/renderer/settings.html src/renderer/settings.js src/renderer/permission.html src/renderer/permission.js dist/renderer/ && cp src/renderer/viewer/index.html src/renderer/viewer/viewer.js src/renderer/viewer/viewer.css dist/renderer/viewer/ && cp src/renderer/shared/*.js dist/renderer/shared/ && (cp src/renderer/stack/* dist/renderer/stack/ 2>/dev/null || true) && (cp src/renderer/combine/* dist/renderer/combine/ 2>/dev/null || true) && (cp src/renderer/record/* dist/renderer/record/ 2>/dev/null || true) && cp src/scripts/*.mjs dist/scripts/ && cp src/assets/tray-icon.png src/assets/tray-icon@2x.png dist/assets/
scripts.build: tsc && npm run copy-renderer && npm run bundle-worker
scripts.download-tessdata: mkdir -p tessdata && curl -L -o tessdata/chi_sim.traineddata https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tessdata_fast/raw/main/chi_sim.traineddata && curl -L -o tessdata/eng.traineddata https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tessdata_fast/raw/main/eng.traineddata

extendInfo.NSScreenCaptureUsageDescription: 需要屏幕录制权限以进行截图和录屏
